tests.name: json_view_number_after_minus_valid
tests.intent: Test that json_view correctly parses a valid negative integer number starting with a minus sign followed by a digit.

tests.name: json_view_number_after_minus_invalid
tests.intent: Test that json_view fails to parse a minus sign not followed by a digit, yielding the number_after_minus error.

tests.name: json_view_number_after_minus_empty_after_minus
tests.intent: Test that json_view fails when the input string consists solely of a lone minus sign.

tests.name: json_view_number_positive_no_minus
tests.intent: Test that positive numbers without a minus sign parse normally through the regular path.

tests.name: json_view_number_zero
tests.intent: Test parsing of numeric zero via json_view document builder.

tests.name: json_view_number_negative_zero
tests.intent: Test parsing of negative zero via json_view document builder.

tests.name: json_view_number_negative_float
tests.intent: Test parsing of a negative floating point number with a fraction and exponent.

tests.name: json_view_number_minus_space
tests.intent: Test parsing behavior when a minus sign is followed by a whitespace character.

tests.name: json_view_number_minus_alpha
tests.intent: Test parsing when a minus sign is followed by an alphabetical letter instead of a digit.

tests.name: json_view_number_multiple_minus
tests.intent: Test parsing behavior when multiple consecutive minus signs are supplied.

tests.name: json_view_number_minus_decimal_point
tests.intent: Test parsing when a minus sign is directly followed by a decimal point.

tests.name: json_view_array_negative_numbers
tests.intent: Test parsing an array containing several negative numbers via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_object_negative_values
tests.intent: Test parsing an object with negative number values via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_number_min_int
tests.intent: Test parsing the minimum standard 32-bit integer boundary value in a negative number.

tests.name: json_view_number_single_digit_negative
tests.intent: Test parsing of single-digit negative numbers.

tests.name: json_view_number_trailing_garbage
tests.intent: Test parsing failure when a negative number is followed by trailing invalid characters.

tests.intent: Test parsing a large negative integer via json_view.

tests.name: json_view_number_minus_tab
tests.intent: Test parsing when a minus sign is followed immediately by a tab character.
